description:
Everything ailiste's page says about one building, by its ailiste id or its page's address: the
developer and its site, the stage and the day we saw it, our photographs, delivery, floors, homes,
bedrooms, sizes, views, amenities, where the map draws it, the asking price it starts at, and what is
for sale in it by size - the asking prices and areas its page lists - with how many of the developer's
own homes are available. The adverts' own links and sellers are not returned.

id.description: The building's ailiste id, 8 letters and digits, or the address of its ailiste page.
id.title: Id

lang.description: The language of the names and links in the answer: en (English), el (Greek), ru (Russian), uk (Ukrainian), he (Hebrew) or zh (Chinese).
lang.title: Lang
